title: Background drain hits the 20 s deadline: in-flight work aborts, the epoch still closes

preconditions.notes: No tool step is open, so the drain has only VFS/HTTP work to settle; the 20 s deadline is the constant of budgets.md section 1.

timeline.detail: admission closes, the 20 s deadline and the background task start, the drain target is Parked
in-flight channel requests are aborted; the epoch close still runs
materialized copy fsynced, epoch-close record appended, segments and manifest made durable, then VFS_ACK level 2 (wal.md section 5.2)
admission stays closed until scenePhase active

notes: The controller test drives an injected clock and a recording epoch closer, so what a test asserts here is that the close is INVOKED exactly once on the way to Parked; the level-2 durability of that close is the fsync and manifest order of wal.md section 5.2. Android has no 20 s window (onTimeout is seconds and a force-stop is zero-callback), so the runner must not weaken the level-1 write path to depend on this close.
